attrPattern.name: pattern
attrPattern.comment: Which of Modo's procedural textures: its own 0 to 7, Enhance: Modo's from 100

attrType.name: type
attrType.comment: The pattern's own Type, as Modo numbers it

attrOutput.name: output
attrOutput.comment: 0 the colour, 1 the alpha as grey

attrSpace.name: space
attrSpace.comment: Where the pattern is laid out before the locator's placement: 0 world, 1 object, 2 texture u and v

attrRow0.name: row0
attrRow0.comment: A row of the placement into the locator's space: x, y, z and offset

attrRow1.name: row1
attrRow1.comment: A row of the placement into the locator's space: x, y, z and offset

attrRow2.name: row2
attrRow2.comment: A row of the placement into the locator's space: x, y, z and offset

attrSettings.name: settings
attrSettings.comment: The pattern's settings in the order of procedurals.MAP_SETTINGS or ENHANCE, up to 22; the 23rd and 24th are its bias and gain

attrInput.name: input
attrInput.comment: For a process (pattern 400 on): the colour beneath it, from which it makes its own
